title: Gitler nega Moskvani ololmadi?
caption:
U urushni qishgacha tugatmoqchi edi. Qish esa boshqacha hal qildi ❄️

Oilangizda urushga ketgan bobongiz bormi? Ismini yozing — xotirasi yashasin 👇

#99foiz #tarix #ikkinchijahonurushi #1941 #xotira #ozbekcha #uzbekistan #reels
hero: hikoyachi + o'zbek askar Ergash (19, oddiy askar, xat yozadi) + toshkentlik temirchi oilasi (orqadan/uzoqdan); Gitlerning yuzi va natsist ramzlari CHIZILMAYDI
facts: 22.06.1941 Barbarossa: ~4 mln Axis askari, 1800 mil front (Lumen World History)
5.12.1941 Moskva ostida 500 mingdan ortiq yangi qo'shin bilan qarshi hujum, nemislar 200 mildan ortiq orqaga surildi; nemis armiyasi qishga tayyor emas edi (Lumen)
O'zbekistondan ~1,5 mln frontga, 420 ming halok; ~0,5 mln evakuatsiya qilinganlar qabul qilindi; Shomahmudovlar 14 bolani asrab oldi (O'zbekiston BMT vakolatxonasi)

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [serious] Gitler Moskvaga yetib kelgan edi. Lekin nega uni ololmadi?
scenes.text: Gitler Moskvaga yetib kelgan edi. Lekin nega uni ololmadi?
scenes.frames: old parchment map of Eastern Europe on a wooden desk, dark arrows stopping just short of a circled Moscow, fast camera push-in, big on-screen question

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [serious] Uning rejasi — qish kelmasdan g'alaba. Javobi esa eng oxirida.
scenes.text: Uning rejasi — qish kelmasdan g'alaba. Javobi esa eng oxirida.
scenes.frames: close-up of a ticking pocket watch lying on an old military map with Moscow circled

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [calm] Qirq birinchi yil, yigirma ikkinchi iyun. Tong sahar...
scenes.text: Qirq birinchi yil, yigirma ikkinchi iyun. Tong sahar...
scenes.frames: dawn over a quiet border river in summer, birds flying, mist; on-screen date 22.06.1941

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [tense] Chegaradan to'rt millionga yaqin askar bostirib kirdi.
scenes.text: Chegaradan to'rt millionga yaqin askar bostirib kirdi.
scenes.frames: endless columns of 1940s tanks and trucks on a dusty road seen from far away, silhouettes only, no insignia or flags; on-screen ~4 000 000

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [tense] Reja ishlayotgandek tuyuldi. Lekin unda bitta katta xato bor edi.
scenes.text: Reja ishlayotgandek tuyuldi. Lekin unda bitta katta xato bor edi.
scenes.frames: 1940s staff officers seen from behind over a big map table with wooden markers, faces not visible, no insignia; one marker tips over, punch-in

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [serious] Har bir shahar, har bir ko'prik uchun og'ir kurash ketdi.
scenes.text: Har bir shahar, har bir ko'prik uchun og'ir kurash ketdi.

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [whispers] Bir soniya... Bu orada uzoq O'zbekistonda nima bo'layotgan edi?
scenes.text: Bir soniya... Bu orada uzoq O'zbekistonda nima bo'layotgan edi?

scenes.speaker: bekzod
